=== ./.github/workflows/search-query-generator.yml ===
name: Search Query Generator

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "40 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: "Dry run: не коммитить результаты"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      commit_generated:
        description: "Коммитить сгенерированные запросы"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
      target:
        description: "Целевой проект/репозиторий"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      max_repo_queries:
        description: "Лимит запросов для репозиториев"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "1200"
      max_code_queries:
        description: "Лимит запросов для кода"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "800"
      seed:
        description: "Seed"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "1337"

concurrency:
  group: search-query-generator
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.11"
  OUTPUT_DIR: ".github/generated"
  GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
  TARGET: ${{ github.event.inputs.target || '' }}
  MAX_REPO_QUERIES: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_repo_queries || '1200' }}
  MAX_CODE_QUERIES: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_code_queries || '800' }}
  SEED: ${{ github.event.inputs.seed || '1337' }}

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  generate:
    name: Generate queries
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Generate
        run: |
          mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"
          python <<'PYEOF'
          import json, os, hashlib, random, re, datetime as dt

          seed = int(os.getenv("SEED", "1337"))
          random.seed(seed)
          out_dir = os.getenv("OUTPUT_DIR", ".github/generated")
          os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

          SUB_PROTOCOLS = [
              "vless", "vmess", "xray", "reality", "sing-box",
              "singbox", "clash", "clash-meta", "mihomo",
              "shadowsocks", "trojan", "hysteria", "hysteria2",
              "tuic", "wireguard", "proxy", "vpn",
          ]
          SUB_INTENTS_EN = [
              "subscription", "subscriptions", "sub", "nodes",
              "free nodes", "proxy list", "aggregator", "mirror",
              "archive", "daily update",
          ]
          SUB_INTENTS_RU = [
              "подписка", "подписки", "узлы", "конфиги",
              "обход блокировок", "остаться на связи",
              "рабочие подписки",
          ]
          TG_PROTOCOLS = [
              "mtproto", "mtproxy", "telegram proxy", "tg proxy",
              "t.me proxy",
          ]
          TG_INTENTS_EN = [
              "proxy", "proxies", "mtproto proxy", "mtproxy list",
              "free proxy", "secret",
          ]
          TG_INTENTS_RU = [
              "телеграм прокси", "тг прокси", "мтпрокси",
              "прокси список", "бесплатный прокси",
          ]
          UTIL_PROTOCOLS = [
              "v2ray", "xray", "vless", "vmess", "sing-box",
              "clash", "mihomo", "shadowsocks", "trojan",
              "hysteria", "wireguard", "proxy", "vpn",
          ]
          UTIL_INTENTS_EN = [
              "client", "gui", "app", "manager", "dashboard",
              "desktop", "mobile", "release",
          ]
          UTIL_INTENTS_RU = [
              "клиент", "приложение", "программа", "интерфейс",
              "менеджер", "утилита",
          ]
          PLATFORMS = [
              "android", "ios", "windows", "linux", "macos",
              "desktop", "mobile",
          ]
          TOPICS = [
              "v2ray", "xray", "vless", "vmess", "reality",
              "sing-box", "clash", "mihomo", "shadowsocks",
              "trojan", "hysteria", "tuic", "wireguard", "proxy",
              "vpn", "subscription", "mtproto", "mtproxy",
          ]
          SUB_FILENAMES = [
              "sub.txt", "subscribe.txt", "subscription.txt",
              "v2ray.txt", "nodes.txt", "proxy.txt", "clash.yaml",
              "config.yaml", "mihomo.yaml", "sing-box.json",
          ]
          TG_FILENAMES = [
              "mtproxy.txt", "tg-proxy.txt", "telegram-proxy.txt",
              "proxy.txt", "list.txt", "mtproxy.json",
          ]

          def cs(v):
              return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", v or "").strip()

          def qid(q):
              return hashlib.md5(q.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]

          def bq(*parts):
              c = []
              for p in parts:
                  if not p:
                      continue
                  p = cs(str(p))
                  if p:
                      c.append(p)
              return cs(" ".join(c))

          def entry(cat, qt, q, pri, reason, qual=None):
              q = cs(q)
              if not q:
                  return None
              qual = qual or []
              fq = cs(" ".join([q] + qual))
              return {
                  "id": qid(fq),
                  "category": cat,
                  "type": qt,
                  "query": q,
                  "full_query": fq,
                  "qualifiers": qual,
                  "priority": pri,
                  "reason": reason,
              }

          def finalize(entries, limit, cat, qt):
              seen = set()
              uniq = []
              for e in entries:
                  if not e:
                      continue
                  k = cs(e["full_query"].lower())
                  if k in seen:
                      continue
                  seen.add(k)
                  uniq.append(e)
              for e in uniq:
                  e["_n"] = random.random()
              uniq.sort(key=lambda x: (x["priority"], x["_n"]), reverse=True)
              if limit > 0 and len(uniq) > limit:
                  uniq = uniq[:limit]
              res = []
              for i, e in enumerate(uniq, 1):
                  e.pop("_n", None)
                  e["slug"] = f"{cat}-{qt}-{i:04d}"
                  res.append(e)
              return res

          def sub_repo():
              e = []
              for p in SUB_PROTOCOLS:
                  for i in SUB_INTENTS_EN:
                      e.append(entry(
                          "subscriptions", "repo", bq(p, i), 92,
                          "protocol+intent",
                          ["fork:true", "archived:false"],
                      ))
              for i in SUB_INTENTS_RU:
                  e.append(entry(
                      "subscriptions", "repo", bq(p, i), 88,
                      "protocol+ru", ["fork:true", "archived:false"],
                  ))
              for p in SUB_PROTOCOLS:
                  for pl in PLATFORMS:
                      e.append(entry(
                          "subscriptions", "repo",
                          bq(p, pl, "subscription"), 84,
                          "protocol+platform",
                          ["fork:true", "archived:false"],
                      ))
              now = dt.datetime.utcnow()
              for d in [7, 30, 90, 180]:
                  date = (now - dt.timedelta(days=d)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                  for p in SUB_PROTOCOLS[:10]:
                      e.append(entry(
                          "subscriptions", "repo",
                          bq(p, "subscription", f"pushed:>{date}"),
                          80, "recent",
                          ["fork:true", "archived:false"],
                      ))
              return e

          def sub_code():
              e = []
              terms = SUB_PROTOCOLS + SUB_INTENTS_EN
              for t in terms:
                  for f in SUB_FILENAMES:
                      e.append(entry(
                          "subscriptions", "code",
                          bq(t, f"filename:{f}"), 86, "term+filename",
                      ))
              return e

          def sub_topic():
              return [
                  entry(
                      "subscriptions", "topic", f"topic:{t}", 80,
                      "topic", ["fork:true", "archived:false"],
                  )
                  for t in TOPICS
              ]

          def tg_repo():
              e = []
              for t in TG_PROTOCOLS + TG_INTENTS_EN + TG_INTENTS_RU:
                  e.append(entry(
                      "tg_proxies", "repo", bq(t), 90, "tg base",
                      ["fork:true", "archived:false"],
                  ))
              for p in TG_PROTOCOLS:
                  for i in TG_INTENTS_EN:
                      e.append(entry(
                          "tg_proxies", "repo", bq(p, i), 92,
                          "tg proto+intent",
                          ["fork:true", "archived:false"],
                      ))
              return e

          def tg_code():
              e = []
              for t in TG_PROTOCOLS + TG_INTENTS_EN:
                  for f in TG_FILENAMES:
                      e.append(entry(
                          "tg_proxies", "code",
                          bq(t, f"filename:{f}"), 88,
                          "tg term+filename",
                      ))
              for pat in [
                  "tg://proxy", "t.me/proxy",
                  "server port secret", "mtproxy secret",
              ]:
                  e.append(entry("tg_proxies", "code", pat, 95, "tg pattern"))
              return e

          def util_repo():
              e = []
              for p in UTIL_PROTOCOLS:
                  for i in UTIL_INTENTS_EN:
                      e.append(entry(
                          "utilities", "repo", bq(p, i), 92,
                          "util proto+intent",
                          ["fork:true", "archived:false"],
                      ))
              for i in UTIL_INTENTS_RU:
                  e.append(entry(
                      "utilities", "repo", bq(p, i), 85,
                      "util proto+ru", ["fork:true", "archived:false"],
                  ))
              for p in UTIL_PROTOCOLS:
                  for pl in PLATFORMS:
                      e.append(entry(
                          "utilities", "repo", bq(p, pl, "client"),
                          90, "util proto+platform",
                          ["fork:true", "archived:false"],
                      ))
              return e

          def util_code():
              e = []
              for t in (UTIL_PROTOCOLS + UTIL_INTENTS_EN)[:40]:
                  e.append(entry(
                      "utilities", "code", bq(t, "filename:README.md"),
                      70, "util term+filename",
                  ))
              return e

          def util_topic():
              extra_topics = ["client", "gui", "app", "release"]
              return [
                  entry(
                      "utilities", "topic", f"topic:{t}", 82,
                      "util topic", ["fork:true", "archived:false"],
                  )
                  for t in TOPICS + extra_topics
              ]

          mr = int(os.getenv("MAX_REPO_QUERIES", "1200"))
          mc = int(os.getenv("MAX_CODE_QUERIES", "800"))

          sr = finalize(sub_repo(), mr, "subscriptions", "repo")
          sc = finalize(sub_code(), mc, "subscriptions", "code")
          st = finalize(sub_topic(), 300, "subscriptions", "topic")
          tr = finalize(tg_repo(), mr, "tg_proxies", "repo")
          tc = finalize(tg_code(), mc, "tg_proxies", "code")
          ur = finalize(util_repo(), mr, "utilities", "repo")
          uc = finalize(util_code(), mc, "utilities", "code")
          ut = finalize(util_topic(), 300, "utilities", "topic")

          payload = {
              "generated_at": dt.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z",
              "generator": "search-query-generator.yml",
              "target": os.getenv("TARGET", ""),
              "categories": {
                  "subscriptions": {"repo": sr, "code": sc, "topic": st},
                  "tg_proxies": {"repo": tr, "code": tc},
                  "utilities": {"repo": ur, "code": uc, "topic": ut},
              },
              "summary": {
                  "subscriptions_repo": len(sr),
                  "subscriptions_code": len(sc),
                  "subscriptions_topic": len(st),
                  "tg_proxies_repo": len(tr),
                  "tg_proxies_code": len(tc),
                  "utilities_repo": len(ur),
                  "utilities_code": len(uc),
                  "utilities_topic": len(ut),
              }
          }

          path = os.path.join(out_dir, "queries.json")
          with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              json.dump(payload, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

          for qt, entries in [("repo", sr), ("code", sc), ("topic", st)]:
              path = os.path.join(
                  out_dir, f"queries_subscriptions_{qt}.txt")
              with open(path, "w") as f:
                  for e in entries:
                      f.write(e["full_query"] + "\n")
              mx = [
                  {
                      "slug": e["slug"],
                      "query": e["query"],
                      "full_query": e["full_query"],
                      "priority": e["priority"],
                  }
                  for e in entries
              ]
              path = os.path.join(
                  out_dir, f"matrix_subscriptions_{qt}.json")
              with open(path, "w") as f:
                  json.dump(mx, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

          for qt, entries in [("repo", tr), ("code", tc)]:
              path = os.path.join(
                  out_dir, f"queries_tg_proxies_{qt}.txt")
              with open(path, "w") as f:
                  for e in entries:
                      f.write(e["full_query"] + "\n")
              mx = [
                  {
                      "slug": e["slug"],
                      "query": e["query"],
                      "full_query": e["full_query"],
                      "priority": e["priority"],
                  }
                  for e in entries
              ]
              path = os.path.join(
                  out_dir, f"matrix_tg_proxies_{qt}.json")
              with open(path, "w") as f:
                  json.dump(mx, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

          for qt, entries in [("repo", ur), ("code", uc), ("topic", ut)]:
              path = os.path.join(
                  out_dir, f"queries_utilities_{qt}.txt")
              with open(path, "w") as f:
                  for e in entries:
                      f.write(e["full_query"] + "\n")
              mx = [
                  {
                      "slug": e["slug"],
                      "query": e["query"],
                      "full_query": e["full_query"],
                      "priority": e["priority"],
                  }
                  for e in entries
              ]
              path = os.path.join(
                  out_dir, f"matrix_utilities_{qt}.json")
              with open(path, "w") as f:
                  json.dump(mx, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

          print("=== Summary ===")
          for k, v in payload["summary"].items():
              print(f"{k}: {v}")
          print(f"Total: {sum(payload['summary'].values())}")
          PYEOF

      - name: Validate JSON
        run: |
          python -c "
          import json, glob
          files = glob.glob('.github/generated/**/*.json', recursive=True)
          for f in files:
              with open(f) as fh:
                  json.load(fh)
              print(f'[OK] {f}')
          print(f'Validated {len(files)} files')
          "

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: generated-queries
          path: .github/generated/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Commit
        if: >-
          ${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run != true &&
          github.event.inputs.commit_generated != false }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email \
            "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .github/generated/
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No changes"
          else
            git commit -m "chore(queries): auto-generate [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi

=== ./.github/workflows/subscription-discovery.yml ===
name: Subscription Discovery

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '15 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      max_repos:
        description: 'Max repos to search'
        required: false
        default: '100'
      max_probe:
        description: 'Max subscriptions to probe'
        required: false
        default: '100'

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Search and extract subscriptions
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          MAX_REPOS: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_repos || '100' }}
        run: |
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import json, os, re, base64, time
          from urllib.parse import urlparse
          import requests

          token = os.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN")
          max_repos = int(os.getenv("MAX_REPOS", "100"))
          headers = {
              "Authorization": f"token {token}",
              "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"
          }

          queries = [
              "vless://", "vmess://", "ss://", "trojan://",
              "hysteria2://", "hy2://", "tuic://",
              "shadowsocks subscription", "v2ray subscription",
              "clash subscription", "xray config"
          ]

          found_urls = set()

          for query in queries:
              print(f"[*] Searching: {query}")
              try:
                  params = {
                      "q": query,
                      "sort": "updated",
                      "order": "desc",
                      "per_page": 100
                  }
                  resp = requests.get(
                      "https://api.github.com/search/repositories",
                      headers=headers,
                      params=params,
                      timeout=10
                  )
                  if resp.status_code != 200:
                      continue

                  repos = resp.json().get("items", [])[:max_repos]

                  for repo in repos:
                      repo_name = repo["full_name"]
                      default_branch = repo.get("default_branch", "main")

                      try:
                          tree_url = (
                              f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo_name}"
                              f"/git/trees/{default_branch}?recursive=1"
                          )
                          tree_resp = requests.get(
                              tree_url,
                              headers=headers,
                              timeout=10
                          )
                          if tree_resp.status_code != 200:
                              continue

                          files = tree_resp.json().get("tree", [])
                          sub_files = [
                              f for f in files
                              if f["type"] == "blob" and any(
                                  p in f["path"].lower()
                                  for p in ["subscription", "sub",
                                           "config", "node", "proxy"]
                              )
                          ]

                          for file in sub_files[:20]:
                              raw_url = (
                                  f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/"
                                  f"{repo_name}/{default_branch}/"
                                  f"{file['path']}"
                              )
                              found_urls.add(raw_url)
                      except Exception as e:
                          print(f"[!] Error processing {repo_name}: {e}")
                          continue

                      time.sleep(0.5)
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"[!] Search error for '{query}': {e}")
                  continue

          subscriptions = []
          for url in found_urls:
              try:
                  print(f"[*] Fetching: {url}")
                  resp = requests.get(url, timeout=15, allow_redirects=True)
                  if resp.status_code == 200 and resp.content:
                      content = resp.text
                      subscriptions.append({
                          "url": url,
                          "content": content,
                          "size_bytes": len(content),
                          "discovered_at": time.strftime(
                              "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ",
                              time.gmtime()
                          )
                      })
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"[!] Fetch error: {e}")
                  continue

          os.makedirs("extracted", exist_ok=True)
          output = {
              "generated_at": time.strftime(
                  "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ",
                  time.gmtime()
              ),
              "total_subscriptions": len(subscriptions),
              "subscriptions": subscriptions
          }

          out_file = "extracted/subscriptions_extracted.json"
          with open(out_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              json.dump(output, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
          print(f"[+] Saved {len(subscriptions)} to {out_file}")
          PYEOF

      - name: Install Xray core for strict node checks
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          XRAY_VERSION="v24.12.18"
          XRAY_ARCHIVE="Xray-linux-64.zip"
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 \
            "https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core/releases/download/\
          ${XRAY_VERSION}/${XRAY_ARCHIVE}" \
            --output /tmp/xray.zip
          unzip -q /tmp/xray.zip -d /tmp/xray
          sudo install -m 0755 /tmp/xray/xray /usr/local/bin/xray
          xray version

      - name: Validate and probe subscriptions through Xray
        env:
          MAX_PROBE_SUBSCRIPTIONS: >-
            ${{ github.event.inputs.max_probe || '100' }}
          NODES_PER_SUBSCRIPTION: '100'
          XRAY_PROBE_TIMEOUT: '8'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p checked
          python scripts/probe_subscription_configs.py \
            --input extracted/subscriptions_extracted.json \
            --output checked/subscriptions_probed.json \
            --max-subscriptions ${MAX_PROBE_SUBSCRIPTIONS} \
            --nodes-per-sub ${NODES_PER_SUBSCRIPTION} \
            --timeout ${XRAY_PROBE_TIMEOUT}

      - name: Copy to data directory
        run: |
          mkdir -p data
          cp checked/subscriptions_probed.json \
             data/subscriptions_found.json

      - name: Commit and push
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email \
            "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data/ extracted/ checked/
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "[*] No changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m \
              "🔄 Auto-update: subscriptions with Xray validation"
            git push
          fi

=== ./.github/workflows/export-formats.yml ===
name: Export Proxy Formats

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '15 */6 * * *'  # Every 6 hours at :15
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - "Generate Summary Report"
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  export:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Export to multiple formats
        run: |
          python scripts/export_formats.py

      - name: Create exports archive
        run: |
          if [ -d exports ]; then
            cd exports
            zip -r ../exports.zip .
            cd ..
            echo "[+] Created exports.zip"
          fi

      - name: Generate exports README
        run: |
          cat > exports/README.md << 'EOF'
          # 📦 Exported Proxy Data

          This directory contains proxy data exported in various
          formats for easy integration.

          ## 📁 Available Formats

          ### Plain Text Files

          - `*_simple.txt` - Simple format: `host:port`
          - `*_protocol.txt` - With protocol: `protocol://host:port`
          - `*_detailed.txt` - Detailed: `host:port | protocol | latency`

          ### CSV Files

          - `*_proxies.csv` - Full data with all fields
          - Headers: host, port, protocol, type, latency_ms, verified_at, source

          ### PAC Files

          - `*_proxy.pac` - Proxy Auto-Config files for browsers
          - Can be used in browser proxy settings

          ### Special Formats

          - `telegram_links.txt` - Ready-to-use Telegram
            proxy links (`tg://proxy?...`)

          ### Combined Files

          - `all_proxies.txt` - All HTTP and SOCKS proxies in one file
          - `all_proxies.csv` - All proxies in CSV format
          - `all_proxies.pac` - PAC file with all proxies

          ## 🔄 Update Frequency

          These exports are regenerated every 6 hours automatically.

          ## 📖 Usage Examples

          ### Load proxies in your application

          **Python:**
          ```python
          with open('http_simple.txt') as f:
              proxies = [line.strip() for line in f]
          ```

          **Bash:**
          ```bash
          while IFS= read -r proxy; do
              curl -x "$proxy" https://example.com
          done < http_simple.txt
          ```

          **JavaScript:**
          ```javascript
          const fs = require('fs');
          const proxies = fs.readFileSync('http_simple.txt', 'utf-8')
              .split('\n')
              .filter(line => line.trim());
          ```

          ### Use PAC file in browser

          1. Go to browser proxy settings
          2. Select "Automatic proxy configuration"
          3. Enter URL: `file:///path/to/http_proxy.pac`

          ### Import Telegram proxies

          Open any link from `telegram_links.txt` in Telegram app or browser.

          ## ⚠️ Important Notes

          - Proxies are validated before export
          - Only working proxies are included
          - Latency is measured at validation time
          - Always test proxies in your environment

          ---

          Generated: $(date -u +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC")
          EOF

          echo "[+] Created exports/README.md"

      - name: Commit and push exports
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add exports/ exports.zip
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "[*] No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m \
              "chore: update exported formats [$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)]"
            git push
            echo "[+] Exports updated"
          fi

=== ./.github/workflows/health-monitor.yml ===
name: Health Monitor

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 * * * *'  # Every hour
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  health-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Run health check
        id: health
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          python scripts/health_check.py
          echo "status=$?" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Read health metrics
        id: metrics
        run: |
          if [ -f data/health_metrics.json ]; then
            status=$(jq -r '.overall_status' data/health_metrics.json)
            total=$(jq -r '.total_proxies' data/health_metrics.json)
            echo "status=${status}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "total=${total}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "status=error" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "total=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Update health badge
        run: |
          status="${{ steps.metrics.outputs.status }}"
          color="red"

          case "$status" in
            ok) color="green" ;;
            warning) color="yellow" ;;
            error) color="red" ;;
          esac

          mkdir -p .github/badges
          cat > .github/badges/health.json << EOF
          {
            "schemaVersion": 1,
            "label": "health",
            "message": "$status",
            "color": "$color"
          }
          EOF

          cat > .github/badges/proxies.json << EOF
          {
            "schemaVersion": 1,
            "label": "proxies",
            "message": "${{ steps.metrics.outputs.total }}",
            "color": "blue"
          }
          EOF

      - name: Create issue on failure
        if: steps.metrics.outputs.status == 'error'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const health = JSON.parse(
              fs.readFileSync('data/health_metrics.json', 'utf8'));

            let issueBody = '## 🚨 Health Check Failed\n\n';
            issueBody += `**Timestamp:** ${health.timestamp}\n`;
            issueBody += `**Overall Status:** ❌ ${health.overall_status}\n`;
            issueBody += `**Total Proxies:** ${health.total_proxies}\n\n`;
            issueBody += '### Detailed Status\n\n';

            for (const [category, checks] of Object.entries(health.checks)) {
              issueBody += `#### ${category}\n`;
              issueBody += `- Freshness: ${checks.freshness.status}`
                + ` - ${checks.freshness.message}\n`;
              issueBody += `- Availability: ${checks.availability.count}`
                + ` proxies (min: ${checks.availability.minimum})\n\n`;
            }

            issueBody += '\n---\n';
            issueBody += '_This issue was created automatically '
              + 'by the health monitor workflow._';

            // Check if there's already an open health issue
            const issues = await github.rest.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              labels: 'health-check,automated'
            });

            if (issues.data.length === 0) {
              await github.rest.issues.create({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                title: `🚨 Health Check Failed - `
                  + `${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}`,
                body: issueBody,
                labels: ['health-check', 'automated', 'bug']
              });
              console.log('Created new health check issue');
            } else {
              console.log('Health check issue already exists, '
                + 'skipping creation');
            }

      - name: Close health issues on success
        if: steps.metrics.outputs.status == 'ok'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const issues = await github.rest.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              labels: 'health-check,automated'
            });

            for (const issue of issues.data) {
              await github.rest.issues.update({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: issue.number,
                state: 'closed'
              });

              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: issue.number,
                body: '✅ Health check is now passing. '
                  + 'Closing this issue automatically.'
              });

              console.log(`Closed issue #${issue.number}`);
            }

      - name: Commit health data
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data/health_metrics.json .github/badges/
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "[*] No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "chore: update health metrics [$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)]"
            git push
            echo "[+] Health data updated"
          fi

      - name: Send notification summary
        run: |
          status="${{ steps.metrics.outputs.status }}"
          total="${{ steps.metrics.outputs.total }}"

          case "$status" in
            ok) emoji="✅" ;;
            warning) emoji="⚠️" ;;
            error) emoji="❌" ;;
            *) emoji="❓" ;;
          esac

          echo "::notice::Health Status: $emoji $status | Total Proxies: $total"

=== ./.github/workflows/http-socks-discovery.yml ===
name: HTTP/SOCKS Proxy Discovery

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '25 */2 * * *'  # Every 2 hours at :25
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      max_check:
        description: 'Max proxies to check per type'
        required: false
        default: '1000'
      concurrency_limit:
        description: 'Concurrency limit for validation'
        required: false
        default: '50'

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      CONCURRENCY_LIMIT: >-
        ${{ github.event.inputs.concurrency_limit || '50' }}
      MAX_CHECK_PROXIES: >-
        ${{ github.event.inputs.max_check || '1000' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Create data directories
        run: mkdir -p data extracted checked

      - name: Extract HTTP/SOCKS proxies from GitHub
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "[+] Extracting HTTP/SOCKS proxies from GitHub..."
          python scripts/extract_http_socks_proxies.py

          if [ -f extracted/http_proxies_extracted.json ]; then
            http_count=$(jq '.total_extracted // 0' \
              extracted/http_proxies_extracted.json)
            echo "[+] Extracted ${http_count} HTTP/HTTPS proxies"
          fi

          if [ -f extracted/socks_proxies_extracted.json ]; then
            socks_count=$(jq '.total_extracted // 0' \
              extracted/socks_proxies_extracted.json)
            echo "[+] Extracted ${socks_count} SOCKS proxies"
          fi

      - name: Validate HTTP proxies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ ! -f extracted/http_proxies_extracted.json ]; then
            echo "[!] No HTTP proxies to validate"
            echo '{"generated_at":"'$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\
              '","total_working":0,"proxies":[]}' \
              > data/http_proxies_found.json
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "[+] Validating HTTP/HTTPS proxies..."
          python scripts/validate_http_socks_proxies.py \
            --input extracted/http_proxies_extracted.json \
            --output data/http_proxies_found.json \
            --protocols http https \
            --timeout 10 \
            --max-check ${MAX_CHECK_PROXIES} \
            --concurrency ${CONCURRENCY_LIMIT}

          working=$(jq '.total_working // 0' data/http_proxies_found.json)
          echo "[+] HTTP validation complete: ${working} working"

      - name: Validate SOCKS proxies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [ ! -f extracted/socks_proxies_extracted.json ]; then
            echo "[!] No SOCKS proxies to validate"
            echo '{"generated_at":"'$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\
              '","total_working":0,"proxies":[]}' \
              > data/socks_proxies_found.json
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "[+] Validating SOCKS proxies..."
          python scripts/validate_http_socks_proxies.py \
            --input extracted/socks_proxies_extracted.json \
            --output data/socks_proxies_found.json \
            --protocols socks4 socks5 \
            --timeout 10 \
            --max-check ${MAX_CHECK_PROXIES} \
            --concurrency ${CONCURRENCY_LIMIT}

          working=$(jq '.total_working // 0' data/socks_proxies_found.json)
          echo "[+] SOCKS validation complete: ${working} working"

      - name: Commit and push results
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data/ extracted/ checked/
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "[*] No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m \
              "chore: update HTTP/SOCKS proxy data [$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)]"
            git push
            echo "[+] Changes committed and pushed"
          fi

=== ./.github/workflows/utils-discovery.yml ===
name: Utils Discovery

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '20 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      max_results:
        description: 'Max results per query'
        required: false
        default: '30'
      max_probe:
        description: 'Max utilities to probe'
        required: false
        default: '300'
      min_stars:
        description: 'Minimum stars filter'
        required: false
        default: '0'
      include_readme:
        description: 'Scan README for platforms'
        required: false
        default: 'true'
      dry_run:
        description: 'Skip publishing results'
        required: false
        default: 'false'

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: '3.11'
  OUTPUT_DIR: data

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  collect-candidates:
    name: 4 - Collect utility candidates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 50
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Create directories
        run: mkdir -p raw "${OUTPUT_DIR}"

      - name: Collect utility candidates
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          MAX_RESULTS: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_results || '30' }}
        run: |
          python <<'PYEOF'
          import json
          import os
          import time

          import requests

          GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com"
          TOKEN = os.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")
          MAX_RESULTS = int(os.getenv("MAX_RESULTS", "30"))
          UA = os.getenv("USER_AGENT",
                         "REMAININGCONNECTIONS/1.0")
          OUT_FILE = "raw/utils_candidates.jsonl"

          HEADERS = {
              "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
              "User-Agent": UA,
          }
          if TOKEN:
              HEADERS["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {TOKEN}"

          QUERY_FILES = {
              "code": ".github/generated/"
                      "queries_utilities_code.txt",
              "repo": ".github/generated/"
                      "queries_utilities_repo.txt",
              "topic": ".github/generated/"
                       "queries_utilities_topic.txt",
          }


          def load_queries(slug):
              path = QUERY_FILES[slug]
              if not os.path.exists(path):
                  return []
              with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  lines = [line.strip() for line in f]
              return [line for line in lines if line]


          def strip_qualifiers(query):
              terms = []
              for part in query.split():
                  if ":" not in part:
                      terms.append(part)
              return " ".join(terms)


          def search_repos(query):
              params = {
                  "q": query,
                  "sort": "stars",
                  "order": "desc",
                  "per_page": 30,
              }
              for attempt in range(3):
                  try:
                      r = requests.get(
                          GITHUB_API
                          + "/search/repositories",
                          headers=HEADERS,
                          params=params,
                          timeout=25,
                      )
                  except Exception as exc:
                      print(f"[!] Search error: {exc}")
                      return []
                  if r.status_code == 200:
                      return r.json().get("items", [])
                  if r.status_code in (403, 429):
                      ra = r.headers.get("Retry-After")
                      if ra and ra.isdigit():
                          time.sleep(int(ra))
                      else:
                          time.sleep(6)
                      continue
                  if 500 <= r.status_code < 600:
                      time.sleep(2 + attempt)
                      continue
                  return []
              return []


          def main():
              candidates = {}
              query_count = 0
              for slug in ("code", "repo", "topic"):
                  for query in load_queries(slug):
                      query_count += 1
                      terms = strip_qualifiers(query)
                      if not terms:
                          continue
                      print(f"[*] Searching: {terms}")
                      kept = 0
                      for item in search_repos(terms):
                          if kept >= MAX_RESULTS:
                              break
                          full = item.get("full_name", "")
                          if not full:
                              continue
                          if full in candidates:
                              prev = candidates[full]
                              slugs = prev["query_slugs"]
                              if slug not in slugs:
                                  slugs.append(slug)
                              continue
                          kept += 1
                          desc = item.get("description")
                          stars = item.get(
                              "stargazers_count", 0)
                          forks = item.get(
                              "forks_count", 0)
                          topics = item.get("topics") or []
                          candidates[full] = {
                              "repo": full,
                              "name": item.get("name"),
                              "description": desc,
                              "stars": stars,
                              "forks": forks,
                              "topics": topics,
                              "url": item.get("html_url"),
                              "query_slugs": [slug],
                          }
                      time.sleep(0.5)
              os.makedirs("raw", exist_ok=True)
              with open(OUT_FILE, "w",
                        encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  for cand in candidates.values():
                      line = json.dumps(
                          cand, ensure_ascii=False)
                      f.write(line + "\n")
              print(f"[*] Queries: {query_count}")
              print(f"[+] Candidates: "
                    f"{len(candidates)}")
              print(f"[+] Saved to {OUT_FILE}")


          main()
          PYEOF

      - name: Upload candidates
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: utils-candidates
          path: raw/utils_candidates.jsonl
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

  probe-utilities:
    name: 5 - Probe utilities
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: collect-candidates
    if: ${{ always() }}
    timeout-minutes: 70
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Create directories
        run: mkdir -p raw probed "${OUTPUT_DIR}"

      - name: Download candidates
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: utils-candidates
          path: raw

      - name: Probe utilities
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          MAX_PROBE: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_probe || '300' }}
          INCLUDE_README: >-
            ${{ github.event.inputs.include_readme
            != false && '1' || '0' }}
          MIN_STARS: ${{ github.event.inputs.min_stars || '0' }}
        run: |
          python <<'PYEOF'
          import os, re, json, time, random, datetime, requests

          GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com"
          TOKEN = os.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")
          UA = os.getenv("USER_AGENT", "REMAININGCONNECTIONS/1.0")
          MAX_PROBE = int(os.getenv("MAX_PROBE", "300"))
          INCLUDE_README = os.getenv("INCLUDE_README", "1") == "1"
          MIN_STARS = int(os.getenv("MIN_STARS", "0"))
          UTILS_OUTPUT = os.getenv("OUTPUT_FILE", "data/utils_found.json")

          HEADERS = {"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json", "User-Agent": UA}
          if TOKEN:
              HEADERS["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {TOKEN}"

          session = requests.Session()
          session.headers.update(HEADERS)

          ANDROID_KEYS = [
              "android", ".apk", ".aab", "apk",
              "play google", "f-droid", "fdroid",
              "android app", "android client",
          ]
          IOS_KEYS = [
              "ios", "iphone", "ipad", ".ipa", "ipa",
              "testflight", "app store",
              "ios app", "ios client",
          ]
          WINDOWS_KEYS = [
              "windows", "win64", "win32", "win-arm",
              ".exe", ".msi", ".msix", ".appx",
              "portable.exe", "windows app",
          ]
          LINUX_KEYS = [
              "linux", "ubuntu", "debian", "fedora",
              "archlinux", "arch linux", "appimage",
              ".deb", ".rpm", ".snap", ".flatpak",
              ".pkg.tar.zst", ".tar.gz", ".tar.xz",
              ".tar.zst", ".tar.bz2", "linux app",
          ]

          def now_iso():
              now = datetime.datetime.now(
                  datetime.timezone.utc)
              return now.isoformat().replace(
                  "+00:00", "Z")

          def parse_date(v):
              if not v:
                  return None
              try:
                  v = v.replace("Z", "+00:00")
                  dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(v)
                  if dt.tzinfo is None:
                      dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
                  return dt
              except Exception:
                  return None

          def days_since(dt):
              if not dt:
                  return None
              delta = datetime.datetime.now(
                  datetime.timezone.utc) - dt
              return int(delta.total_seconds()
                         / 86400)

          def fetch_json(url, params=None):
              for attempt in range(3):
                  try:
                      r = session.get(url, params=params, timeout=25)
                      if r.status_code == 200:
                          return r.json()
                      if r.status_code == 404:
                          return None
                      if r.status_code in (403, 429):
                          ra = r.headers.get("Retry-After")
                          wait = int(ra) if ra and ra.isdigit() else 6
                          time.sleep(wait)
                          continue
                      if 500 <= r.status_code < 600:
                          time.sleep(2 + attempt)
                          continue
                      return None
                  except Exception:
                      time.sleep(2 + attempt)
              return None

          def fetch_text(url, accept=None):
              try:
                  headers = {}
                  if accept:
                      headers["Accept"] = accept
                  r = session.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=25)
                  if r.status_code == 200 and r.text:
                      return r.text
                  return None
              except Exception:
                  return None

          def detect_from_text(text, flags):
              if not text:
                  return flags
              low = text.lower()
              if any(x in low for x in ANDROID_KEYS):
                  flags["android"] = True
              if any(x in low for x in IOS_KEYS):
                  flags["ios"] = True
              if any(x in low for x in WINDOWS_KEYS):
                  flags["windows"] = True
              if any(x in low for x in LINUX_KEYS):
                  flags["linux"] = True
              return flags

          def detect_from_asset_name(name):
              flags = {"android": False,
                       "ios": False,
                       "windows": False,
                       "linux": False}
              if not name:
                  return flags
              n = name.lower()
              if n.endswith((".apk", ".aab")) or "android" in n:
                  flags["android"] = True
              if (n.endswith(".ipa") or "ios" in n
                      or "iphone" in n
                      or "ipad" in n):
                  flags["ios"] = True
              if (n.endswith((".exe", ".msi",
                              ".msix", ".appx"))
                      or "windows" in n
                      or ("win" in n
                          and ("64" in n or "32" in n
                               or "arm" in n))):
                  flags["windows"] = True
              if (n.endswith((".appimage", ".deb",
                              ".rpm", ".snap",
                              ".flatpak",
                              ".pkg.tar.zst"))
                      or "linux" in n):
                  flags["linux"] = True
              return flags

          def merge_flags(target, source):
              for key in target:
                  if source.get(key):
                      target[key] = True
              return target

          def platform_labels(flags):
              labels = []
              if flags.get("android"):
                  labels.append("Android")
              if flags.get("ios"):
                  labels.append("iOS")
              if flags.get("windows"):
                  labels.append("Windows")
              if flags.get("linux"):
                  labels.append("Linux")
              return labels

          def make_status(release_age_days, pushed_at):
              if release_age_days is None:
                  pushed_days = days_since(parse_date(pushed_at))
                  if pushed_days is not None and pushed_days <= 90:
                      return "no_release_recent_repo"
                  return "no_release"
              if release_age_days <= 365:
                  return "active"
              if release_age_days <= 730:
                  return "stale"
              return "outdated"

          def calculate_score(stars, flags, release_age_days, has_release):
              platforms_count = sum(1 for x in flags.values() if x)
              score = stars + platforms_count * 2500
              if has_release and release_age_days is not None:
                  score += max(0, 6000 - release_age_days * 8)
              return int(score)

          cands = []
          if os.path.exists("raw/utils_candidates.jsonl"):
              path = "raw/utils_candidates.jsonl"
              with open(path, "r",
                        encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  for line in f:
                      line = line.strip()
                      if not line:
                          continue
                      try:
                          cands.append(json.loads(line))
                      except Exception:
                          continue

          print(f"[*] Candidates: {len(cands)}")

          if MIN_STARS > 0:
              cands = [c for c in cands if c.get("stars", 0) >= MIN_STARS]
              print(f"[*] After stars filter (>= {MIN_STARS}): {len(cands)}")

          cands.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("stars", 0), reverse=True)
          utilities = []

          for idx, c in enumerate(cands[:MAX_PROBE], 1):
              repo = c.get("repo")
              if not repo:
                  continue
              print(f"[*] {idx}/{min(len(cands), MAX_PROBE)}: {repo}")
              rd = fetch_json(f"{GITHUB_API}/repos/{repo}")
              if not rd:
                  time.sleep(1)
                  continue

              full_name = rd.get("full_name", repo)
              html_url = rd.get("html_url", c.get("url"))
              name = rd.get("name", c.get("name", full_name.split("/")[-1]))
              description = rd.get("description") or c.get("description")
              language = rd.get("language")
              topics = rd.get("topics") or c.get("topics") or []
              stars = rd.get("stargazers_count", c.get("stars", 0))
              forks = rd.get("forks_count", c.get("forks", 0))
              pushed_at = rd.get("pushed_at")
              archived = rd.get("archived", False)

              flags = {"android": False,
                       "ios": False,
                       "windows": False,
                       "linux": False}
              detect_from_text(" ".join(topics), flags)
              detect_from_text(name, flags)
              detect_from_text(description, flags)

              rel_url = (f"{GITHUB_API}/repos/"
                         f"{repo}/releases/latest")
              release = fetch_json(rel_url)
              if not release:
                  rels_url = (f"{GITHUB_API}/repos/"
                              f"{repo}/releases")
                  rels = fetch_json(
                      rels_url,
                      params={"per_page": 1})
                  if isinstance(rels, list) and rels:
                      release = rels[0]

              has_release = False
              tag = None
              rname = None
              rurl = None
              rpub = None
              rage = None
              rassets = []

              if release:
                  has_release = True
                  tag = release.get("tag_name")
                  rname = release.get("name") or release.get("tag_name")
                  rurl = release.get("html_url")
                  rpub = (release.get("published_at")
                          or release.get("created_at"))
                  rage = days_since(parse_date(rpub))
                  for asset in (release.get("assets", []) or [])[:20]:
                      an = asset.get("name")
                      au = asset.get("browser_download_url")
                      if not an or not au:
                          continue
                      af = detect_from_asset_name(an)
                      merge_flags(flags, af)
                      rassets.append({
                          "name": an,
                          "url": au,
                          "size_mb": round(
                              (asset.get("size") or 0)
                              / (1024 * 1024), 2),
                          "content_type": asset.get("content_type"),
                          "platform_hint": platform_labels(af),
                      })

              if INCLUDE_README and (
                      not any(flags.values())
                      or not has_release):
                  rm_url = (f"{GITHUB_API}/repos/"
                            f"{repo}/readme")
                  rt = fetch_text(
                      rm_url,
                      accept="application/vnd.github.raw")
                  if rt:
                      detect_from_text(rt[:80000], flags)

              labels = platform_labels(flags)
              status = make_status(rage, pushed_at)
              score = calculate_score(stars, flags, rage, has_release)

              utilities.append({
                  "id": idx,
                  "name": name,
                  "full_name": full_name,
                  "url": html_url,
                  "description": description,
                  "language": language,
                  "topics": topics,
                  "stars": stars,
                  "forks": forks,
                  "archived": archived,
                  "pushed_at": pushed_at,
                  "query_slugs": c.get("query_slugs", []),
                  "has_release": has_release,
                  "latest_release_tag": tag,
                  "latest_release_name": rname,
                  "latest_release_url": rurl,
                  "latest_release_published_at": rpub,
                  "release_age_days": rage,
                  "platforms": flags,
                  "platform_labels": labels,
                  "platforms_text": ", ".join(labels) if labels else "Unknown",
                  "release_assets_count": len(rassets),
                  "release_assets": rassets[:12],
                  "status": status,
                  "score": score,
              })

              time.sleep(random.uniform(0.35, 1.1))

          utilities.sort(key=lambda x: x["score"], reverse=True)
          for idx, item in enumerate(utilities, 1):
              item["id"] = idx

          summary = {
              "total_utilities": len(utilities),
              "with_release": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["has_release"]),
              "without_release": sum(
                  1 for x in utilities
                  if not x["has_release"]),
              "android": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["platforms"]["android"]),
              "ios": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["platforms"]["ios"]),
              "windows": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["platforms"]["windows"]),
              "linux": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["platforms"]["linux"]),
              "active": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["status"] == "active"),
              "stale": sum(1 for x in utilities if x["status"] == "stale"),
              "outdated": sum(
                  1 for x in utilities
                  if x["status"] == "outdated"),
              "no_release": sum(
                  1 for x in utilities
                  if x["status"] == "no_release"),
              "no_release_recent_repo": sum(
                  1 for x in utilities
                  if x["status"]
                  == "no_release_recent_repo"),
          }

          payload = {
              "generated_at": now_iso(),
              "generator": "utils-discovery.yml",
              "project": "REMAININGCONNECTIONS dashboard",
              "telegram_channel": "https://t.me/REMAININGCONNECTIONS",
              "candidates_checked": len(utilities),
              "summary": summary,
              "utilities": utilities,
          }

          os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(UTILS_OUTPUT), exist_ok=True)
          os.makedirs("probed", exist_ok=True)

          with open("probed/utils_probed.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              json.dump(payload, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

          with open(UTILS_OUTPUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              json.dump(payload, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

          print(f"Utilities: {summary['total_utilities']}")
          print(f"With release: {summary['with_release']}")
          print(f"Android: {summary['android']}")
          print(f"iOS: {summary['ios']}")
          print(f"Windows: {summary['windows']}")
          print(f"Linux: {summary['linux']}")
          PYEOF

      - name: Upload utility results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: utils-results
          path: |
            probed/utils_probed.json
            data/utils_found.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email \
            "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git pull --rebase origin "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" || true
          git add data/utils_found.json || true
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "[*] No changes"
          else
            git commit -m "chore(data): update utils_found.json [skip ci]"
            git push origin "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
            echo "[+] Committed"
          fi

  report:

        with:

      - name: Print report
        run: |
          echo "=================================================="
          echo " Utility Discovery Pipeline finished"
          echo "=================================================="
          FILE="$(find utils-report-artifacts -type f \
            -name 'utils_found.json' | head -n 1 || true)"
          if [[ -z "${FILE}" ]]; then
            echo "[!] No results file"
            exit 0
          fi
          python <<PYEOF
          import json
          path = "${FILE}"
          try:
              with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  data = json.load(f)
              summary = data.get("summary", {})
              utilities = data.get("utilities", [])
              print(f"Generated: {data.get('generated_at')}")
              print(f"Utilities: {summary.get('total_utilities')}")
              print(f"With release: {summary.get('with_release')}")
              print(f"Android: {summary.get('android')}")
              print(f"iOS: {summary.get('ios')}")
              print(f"Windows: {summary.get('windows')}")
              print(f"Linux: {summary.get('linux')}")
              print(f"Active: {summary.get('active')}")
              print("\nTop-10 by score:")
              for item in utilities[:10]:
                  print(f"  - {item.get('name')}"
                        f" | stars: {item.get('stars')}"
                        f" | {item.get('platforms_text')}"
                        f" | release: "
                        f"{item.get('latest_release_tag') or 'none'}")
          except Exception as e:
              print(f"[!] Report error: {e}")
          PYEOF
          echo "=================================================="

=== ./.github/workflows/export-and-commit.yml ===
name: Export Code & Validate YAML (Commit to Repo)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'

jobs:
  process:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout репозитория
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Сборка всего кода в TXT
        run: |
          > codebase.txt
          find . -type f \
            -not -path "*/.git/*" \
            -not -name "codebase.txt" \
            -not -name "yaml_errors.txt" \
            -not -name "*.png" -not -name "*.jpg" -not -name "*.ico" \
            -not -name "*.woff2" -not -name "*.ttf" \
            -not -name "*.zip" \
            -not -name "*.pyc" \
            -not -path "*/__pycache__/*" | while read -r file; do
            echo "=== $file ===" >> codebase.txt
            cat "$file" >> codebase.txt 2>/dev/null || \
              echo "[BINARY/UNREADABLE]" >> codebase.txt
            echo "" >> codebase.txt
          done

      - name: Проверка YAML и сохранение ошибок в файл
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python3 -m pip install yamllint
          python3 << 'PYEOF'
          import os
          import subprocess

          yaml_files = []
          for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.'):
              rel = os.path.relpath(root, '.')
              parts = rel.split(os.sep)
              if ('.git' in parts or 'node_modules' in parts or
                      '__pycache__' in parts):
                  continue
              for f in files:
                  if f.endswith(('.yml', '.yaml')):
                      yaml_files.append(os.path.join(root, f))

          with open('yaml_errors.txt', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as out:
              if not yaml_files:
                  out.write("YAML файлы не найдены.\n")
              else:
                  for yf in sorted(yaml_files):
                      out.write(f"\n--- Файл: {yf} ---\n")
                      res = subprocess.run(
                          ['yamllint', '-f', 'parsable', yf],
                          capture_output=True,
                          text=True
                      )

                      errors = [
                          line for line in
                          (res.stdout + res.stderr).split('\n')
                          if line.strip() and 'error' in line.lower()
                      ]

                      if errors:
                          out.write("Последние 3 ошибки:\n")
                          for err in errors[-3:]:
                              out.write(f"  {err}\n")
                      else:
                          out.write("  Ошибок не найдено ✅\n")
          PYEOF

      - name: Коммит и пуш изменений в репозиторий
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email \
            "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add codebase.txt yaml_errors.txt
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "Нет изменений для коммита."
          else
            git commit -m \
              "chore: обновить codebase.txt и yaml_errors.txt [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi
